summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust SMID Growth Strength ETF (FSGS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the SMID Growth Strength index. The fund tracks an index of small and midcap companies with a perceived strong balance sheet and financial performance. FSGS was launched on Jun 20, 2017 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: FSGS is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Elastic stock at 1.57%, PTC Inc. at 1.54%, Veeva Systems at 1.49%, Abercrombie & Fitch Co. at 1.48%, and Halozyme Therapeutics at 1.40%.
